name: killer whale
lore:
The ocean's depths hold many secrets, but few are as awe-inspiring and terrifying as the killer whale. These apex predators, sleek and powerful, patrol the seas with unmatched grace and cunning. Tales abound of pods working in perfect harmony to bring down colossal prey, their coordinated attacks a testament to their intelligence and social bonds.

Imagine the chilling echo of their calls cutting through the water as they hunt, a symphony of nature's raw power. While their reputation precedes them as ruthless hunters, they also display a fierce protectiveness towards their young, a reminder that even the most formidable creatures are bound by the threads of family. Sailors whisper of alliances between orcas and aquatic elves, hinting at a deeper connection between these denizens of the deep. Encountering a killer whale is a brush with the wild, an experience that leaves one both humbled and wary.
